initial:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Use the attached photograph as the sole product authority. Improve the photographic quality and fine detail of these exact two screw caps, black on the left and white on the right.
Keep their geometry locked: identical widths and heights to the reference relative to each other, identical cylindrical silhouette and shallow rounded top, identical ribbing pattern and rib groups, exact lower rim/lip and underside profile. Maintain the same frontal camera angle, side-by-side arrangement, separation and common floor level. These are the two actual caps for a 2 ml sample vial; do not substitute generic closures.
Enhance clarity and edge detail without redesigning or exaggerating the grooves. Preserve the black cap's restrained dark plastic finish and the white cap's soft white plastic finish. Soft neutral studio lighting, warm off-white #F5F3EF background, restrained contact shadows. Both complete caps must be visible, with ample surrounding margin.
No bottle, label, text, logo, extra parts or decorative objects. Do not add knurling, new ridges, metallic trim or new rims. Output one faithful, polished image of the same pair.
